evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp, src/wallet/wallet.h, and src/wallet/init.cpp to decouple transaction rebroadcasting from initial broadcast.
rationale: Decoupling rebroadcasting from initial transaction broadcast addresses a significant wallet privacy leak where periodic announcements to peers reveal transaction ownership. As noted in the description, rebroadcasting unconfirmed transactions periodically to all connected peers 'reveals that the wallet is related to them' and could previously only be turned off by disabling initial broadcasts entirely.
